review_status: Complete smooth construction accepted by the accompanying independent AI-assisted mathematical audit; unrefereed
accepted_claims: For any prescribed essential pair meeting once on an oriented smooth surface, actual orientation-preserving C∞ diffeomorphisms A,B represent the prescribed right Dehn twists and satisfy ABA=BAB as maps.
The maps and their inverses are C∞, so the homeomorphism, C1 and every finite Cr question is answered affirmatively.
The maps have compact support in the interior of any sufficiently small compact regular neighborhood of the pair, with identity on a boundary collar.
The construction fixes existing boundary, marked points and punctures by choosing the neighborhood disjoint from them.
The construction lifts the specified B3→Mod(S) homomorphism; it need not split its image when ambient relations are added.
preserved_prior_correction: Lift of the specified B3→Mod(S) homomorphism, not necessarily a section of its ambient image; extra ambient relations need not hold for the chosen maps.

prior_positive_realization.title: Realization problems for diffeomorphism groups
prior_positive_realization.theorem: Theorem 4.1: smooth realization of B3 on a disk with three marked points

claim_limits: Oriented-surface right-twist convention; more generally, an oriented one-holed-torus regular neighborhood. No convention-free nonorientable-surface claim.
Lifts B3→Mod(S), not necessarily a section of its ambient image when extra relations are imposed.
No realization of the full higher-genus mapping class group.
No novelty, priority, exhaustive literature coverage, external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification claim.
